plugins.name: codeceptjs
plugins.description: Eight skills covering everything an AI agent needs to write, debug, refactor, and fix CodeceptJS 4 tests — including a primer (codeceptjs-fundamentals), live page exploration (codeceptjs-exploration), trace analysis (codeceptjs-run-analysis), the auth plugin recipe (codeceptjs-auth), and four action skills (writing, debugging, refactoring, ci-fix).
